scope: A dependency-only :valtan-resumable declaration selects dual core compilation in ahead-of-time and runtime builds. This is not a full McCLIM validation.

before.runtimeFailure: The dependency function had a resumable implementation, but CL:SLEEP did not; the core functions are dual assertion failed.
before.probeCorrection: The initial ahead-of-time probe incorrectly required the compile-time feature in runtime CL:*FEATURES*. It was corrected to test the source reader branch; the runtime-mode feature assertion remains. The initial ahead-of-time failure is not evidence of the dual-core defect.

checks: Dependency feature reaches application source reader
Dependency function and core SLEEP both have resumable implementations
Scheduled call through SLEEP completes with 42 and leaves no live tasks
Both modes run in a fresh process after deleting Lisp sources and system definitions
Runtime compilation also preserves the feature in CL:*FEATURES*
